units.source_text: 原来是昨天水木真一给千重子来电话，邀她去平安神宫观赏樱花。

en.t: It turned out that Mizuki Shinichi had called Chieko yesterday and invited her to go see the cherry blossoms at Heian Shrine.

units.source_text: 据说真一的朋友—一个学生，在神宫入口担任半个月的检票工作，他告诉真一，现时樱花正盛开。

en.t: Apparently, a friend of Shinichi's, a student, had been working for half a month checking tickets at the shrine entrance, and he told Shinichi that the cherry blossoms were now in full bloom.
